scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm calling to check on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and haven't heard anything yet.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, ID LOAN-00083, has been originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear that it's originated! Can you tell me if my application was approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: The action taken on your loan application was 'Loan originated'.

dialogue.user: Okay, so it was approved then. That's a relief! Can you tell me what the interest rate is for this loan, and what the total costs will be?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 6.740%. The total loan costs field is not applicable for this loan.

dialogue.user: That's a bit higher than I was expecting. Could you tell me what the loan term is on this? And also, has this loan been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The loan term is 360 months. The purchaser type is not applicable, meaning the loan was not sold or transferred.

dialogue.user: I see. And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for this application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is categorized as 30%-<36%. This ratio compares your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income.

dialogue.user:
Okay, I think I have the information I need. Thank you.

<Satisfied> I'm satisfied with the interaction. You were able to answer my questions about the loan status and the terms.
